description_en: Adds personnel information to a cost center
description_zh: 增加成本中心人员信息
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen entity-add --thirdpart-id 340049 --entity-d-o-list entity_type=1 entity_id=12345 --x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: EntityAdd

parameters.help_en: The ID of the third-party cost center
parameters.name: thirdpart_id

element_fields.help_en:
The type of the available scope. Valid values:

- 1: employee
- 2: department
- 3: role
- 4: third-party department
element_fields.name: entity_type

element_fields.help_en: The ID of the employee, department, role, or third-party department
element_fields.help_zh: 员工/部门/角色id/第三方部门id
element_fields.name: entity_id

parameters.help_en: The list of employee, department, or role information
parameters.help_zh: 员工/部门/角色信息列表
parameters.name: entity_d_o_list

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the enterprise access credential operation. Add it to the request header. In HTTP mode, you can use so_corp_token=value or dtb_corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数 由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用so_corp_token=value或者dtb_corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token
